name: Restorative Ointment
description: A small glass jar of thick green salve.
body:
## What it does

As an action, one dose is swallowed or rubbed into the skin: it heals 2d8 + 2 hit points and ends poison and disease. The jar holds 1d4 + 1 doses when found; count each dose as one.

features.name: Restore
features.text: A dose also ends poison and disease.
